item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena wraps an insulated copper wire around an iron nail and connects the ends to a cell to make an electromagnet for a school project. She uses it to pick up steel paper clips.
Which statement about her electromagnet is correct?

options.A: The nail stays magnetised and keeps holding the clips even after the current is switched off.
options.B: The iron nail inside the coil makes the electromagnet weaker.
options.C: Without the iron nail, the current-carrying coil cannot behave like a magnet at all.
options.D: The current-carrying coil behaves like a magnet, and the iron nail inside the coil makes the electromagnet stronger.
